cases.observation: Forged (table, context, generation, kind, rights, representation) and cross-host claims reach only direct Host::read fixtures: a guest always presents the retained handle. Each is refused with invalid-handle before any protected read, and the owner is unchanged until its single release.

Host::read passes native_access only the borrow begin has just opened, and T4 proves the table authorizes it (open_borrow_returns, proofs/m5/RegionTable.lean). No direct Host fixture reaches the refusal without corrupting table state.

cases.observation: The audited host answers a read only with ok bytes of the requested length, bounds-reject or invalid-handle (A3), and no modified host is built. The executed variants return unmodeled results from the guest, exercising the adapter's outside-model class. The traces a modified host would record, an ok one byte short and err("timeout"), are monitor controls that must be reported as outside-model.

assumptions: Every executed scenario is one public `noble component read-region --report v2` invocation of the CLI built from this commit, over the compiled subject or a hostile component assembled here.
The hostile components are core modules written in this script against the selected WIT world's synchronous memory32 Canonical ABI, not derived from Noble compiler output.

The monitor replays each recorded trace against the RegionProtocol-v1 transition table. Its verdicts describe these finite executions only; a call the runtime refused before it reached the host leaves no event to judge.

Cancellation is the --cancel-after-reads test knob: the host cancels after answering the requested number of reads, refuses every later call and interrupts the guest through a Wasmtime epoch deadline.
Quota placement uses the --fuel test knob; the boundary found by search is a property of this subject, CLI and Wasmtime build.
